item.title: Season 10 opens — 13 Sep 2026
item.description: Season 10 opened with sixteen players across three brackets and five rounds. Scott went through the over-1400s untouched at 5–0, with Alex, Harold and Mathew a full two points back on 3. In the under-1400s Omar Cruz dropped only one game for 4 of 5, a point clear of Josh, while Zack, Brian O and Mel finished level on 2. The under-1000s were the tightest bracket of the night: Sonny and Maddie shared first on 2 points. Derek, Thomas, Diego and Sam left before the last round; their scores stand as played.
